verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way for a Segment user to opt out of Segment's own telemetry or usage tracking in its SDKs, CLI, or app. The Consent Management and Privacy Portal material covers enforcing end-user consent for data the customer collects through Segment. That is an adjacent capability, not an opt-out from the product's own telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
